title: Touch hunt
offscreen: Put three of the things you found in a bag: the child reaches in and says what each one is like, without looking.

items.label: Something soft
items.say: Look for something soft to touch with your hands.

items.label: Something hard
items.say: Now something hard. Touch it carefully.

items.label: Something smooth
items.say: And now something smooth, that slides under your fingers.

items.label: Something rough
items.say: Look for something rough, that scratches a little under your fingers.

items.label: Something heavy
items.say: Something heavy, but that you can carry by yourself.

items.label: Something cold
items.say: And something cold to touch, like a spoon or a bowl.

intro.bo: {nome}, shall we go on a treasure hunt? You look in your own time, one thing at a time.
intro.pilu: {nome}, I'll tell you something to look for. Look carefully around you: treasures are everywhere.
intro.tango: Treasure hunt, {nome}! I'm coming too! ...No, I'll stay here. You look, slowly.

outro.bo: So many treasures, {nome}. Now each one goes back in its place, so we can find them again tomorrow.
outro.pilu: Every treasure goes back where you found it, {nome}: that's part of the game too.
outro.tango: What a hunt! {nome}, shall we put everything back? I'll... I'll keep an eye on it.
